ops.title: Which cc-transcript Python modules can become native-backed facades vs which stay Python (v14 P6 deletion sweep)
ops.body:
The v14 P6 deletion sweep converts Python reference modules to thin facades over the native (`_native`) aggregators, following the `mining/engine.py` rehydrate pattern (Python compute dies, native computes, Python keeps only the public typed dataclass surface + docstrings).

**The load-bearing split** (discovered by running the native aggregators on real fixtures): a module can become a native facade ONLY if its public function's input can be raw-bytes / a path / a string. The native aggregators are path/raw-based (they self-parse) and several are lossy, and there is NO event→JSONL serializer in the package.

CONVERTED (input is raw/path/string): command.py (native view classes + `CommandLine.parse`), cost.py (`cost_of_json`), facts.py (`tool_facts`, went path-based, v14-breaking), render.py raw renderers (`render_compact_lines/haystacks/stats`), context.py capture (`context_capture_window`, went `(raw, anchor)`, v14-breaking). backend.py deleted (ParsedTranscript had 0 importers after facts/render converted).

SURVIVED (irreducible — public fn operates on already-parsed in-memory events): activity.py/query.py (rich Turn.events/ToolUse.call structuring; `activity_lift`/`query_session` are LOSSY = metrics only; load-bearing for evidence.py which is not a deletion target), notifications.py (`Session.notifications` replays a WINDOWED slice; native replay is whole-file-raw), sentiment/buckets.py (event-based + native returns uuids not events), the filterspec POST-PARSE leg (`apply_spec`/`keep` — no native "filter a materialized event list" op; the FilterSpec tree + `spec_to_json` parse-time builder survive), mining/formats·filterspec·sampling.

Consequence: the ~4,000–4,500 LOC target is UNREACHABLE without new Rust rich-view / post-parse-filter bindings (the team lead declined that scope expansion). P6 landed cc_transcript/ at ~9,200 LOC (from 10,185). Deps dropped from runtime: click/aiosqlite/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-bash (0 consumers); anyio→dev extra; orjson STAYS (parser + spec serializers + models.ReadOnlyDict). See [[cc-family-v8-release-mechanics]] for release mechanics and [[cc-transcript-build-env]] for the worktree build recipe.
